rationale: CBRS has gapped up 11.2% and is printing at the absolute top of today's range (position 100%) after a sharp two-candle surge from $108.70 to $117.52 on extreme relative volume (6.38x). Chasing a long at the high of a parabolic gap-and-run with a 17.9 bps spread and no consolidation is poor risk/reward, while a short against a stock showing this kind of momentum and buying pressure is equally dangerous. With only two one-minute candles of price history and no clear exhaustion signal, the cleanest action is to wait for structure to develop before committing capital.
